function.name: run_sql
function.arguments:
{"sql":"SELECT s.sku,
       c.channel,
       SUM(CASE WHEN s.period='2026-08' THEN s.revenue_cad END) AS rev_aug,
       SUM(CASE WHEN s.period='2026-08' THEN s.qty END) AS qty_aug,
       SUM(CASE WHEN s.period='2026-09' THEN s.revenue_cad END) AS rev_sep,
       SUM(CASE WHEN s.period='2026-09' THEN s.qty END) AS qty_sep,
       SUM(CASE WHEN s.period='2026-08' THEN s.revenue_cad END)/NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN s.period='2026-08' THEN s.qty END),0) AS aug_asp,
       SUM(CASE WHEN s.period='2026-09' THEN s.revenue_cad END)/NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN s.period='2026-09' THEN s.qty END),0) AS sep_asp
FROM lightning.metastore.finmozg.finance_usl.sales_line s
JOIN lightning.metastore.finmozg.finance_usl.customer c ON s.customer_id = c.customer_id
WHERE s.period IN ('2026-08', '2026-09')
GROUP BY s.sku, c.channel
HAVING aug_asp IS NOT NULL AND sep_asp IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY ABS(aug_asp - sep_asp) DESC
LIMIT 20","purpose":"Find SKU-channel pairs with largest ASP change between Aug and Sep"}
